_comment: Seeded bugfix instances mined from document-pipeline's own history. prep.sh archives each fix commit's PARENT (the buggy state, before the fix and before its test existed); the matching hidden test in hidden/<name>/ is copied into the sandbox only at grade time by provider.js. Run prep.sh once before the agentic suite (needs a local document-pipeline checkout). NOTE: a bugfix instance is only robust if its hidden test exercises EXPORTED/stable API (e.g. dbba582 -> GenerateEmbed). Tests that pin a private function's signature are fragile — a refactoring agent changes the signature and the test stops compiling (why 63647ca/findInput and 88ad1ec/buildQAFollowup were dropped).
